prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree that fast-coder's context window is 262144, permanently.

[action]
- Read the folder: `models.json` is the single source (131072 for fast-coder), `gen.py` generates `out/` from it, and `out/opencode.json` was already at 262144 while `out/codex.toml` and `out/claude.json` had 131072 — so editing only `out/` would have been reverted on the next `python gen.py`.
- Fixed the source of truth: `models.json` fast-coder `context_window` 131072 → 262144 (nothing else in the file touched).
- Ran `python gen.py` to regenerate `out/` from the fixed source, after backing up the old `out/`.
- Diffed regenerated vs backup: exactly two lines changed — `codex.toml` line 2 (`context_window = 262144`) and `claude.json` line 5 (`"contextWindow": 262144`). `opencode.json` regenerated byte-identical. Backup removed.

[result] Verified by grepping every file: fast-coder is now 262144 in all of `models.json`, `out/opencode.json` (line 9), `out/codex.toml` (line 2) and `out/claude.json` (line 5); deep-thinker stays 200000 and tiny-chat stays 32768 in all files, and the pre/post diff proves no other setting (output limits, tool_call flags, structure) changed. No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened, so nothing to close.

Assumptions: the `out/` files and `models.json` are the only configs involved (the harness install step copies `out/` per the README), and "for good" means surviving a future `python gen.py` regeneration — hence fixing the source, not just the outputs.

[next] Nothing further; if the harness ever pulls model data from a live endpoint instead of these files, that upstream would need the same 262144 value.
